newsitem.title: CHINA: China says arable land larger than once estimated.
newsitem.headline: China says arable land larger than once estimated.

text.p: China has 147 million hectares of arable land, much larger than earlier estimates had shown, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
This indicates that arable land represents 15.3 percent of China's total territory, it said.
In June, China said a nationwide survey had found China had 133.4 million hectares of farmland, far more than the 95 million hectares counted in 1994.

However, the land area was not enough given the need to feed a population of 1.2 billion, Xinhua said, adding that China planned to turn 300,000 hectares of wasteland into arable land each year over the next few decades.
